text:
Dana Kim: FYI partner 'NimbleStack' raised a ticket: Azure Marketplace payout for April shows 'on-hold' status for 2026-04-06 settlements. They say funds not released.
Oliver Park: which settlement ids? can you drop the payout csv?
Dana Kim: s3://redwood-prod/finance/payouts/2026-04/nimblestack-april.csv. main ids 501110, 501111, 501130.
FinanceBot: Reconciliation run 2026-04-10T02:03Z flagged 3 items with marketplace_status='on_hold' and our payment_status='scheduled'. Case RB-9723 opened.
Maya Patel: Azure sometimes places holds for compliance review if pricing metric change detected. do we have any recent price-change events for NimbleStack?
Azure-Partner-Bot: Marketplace event: listing_update detected for vendor NimbleStack on 2026-04-05 23:58Z. metric_change=true.
Oliver Park: ledger query: ```sql
SELECT settlement_id, marketplace_status, payment_status, bank_ref
FROM payouts
WHERE partner='NimbleStack' AND month='2026-04';
-- returns 501110:on_hold/scheduled/null, 501111:on_hold/scheduled/null, 501130:on_hold/scheduled:null
```
Dana Kim: partner accounting confirms they saw 'pending compliance review' in Azure portal and asked for ETA.
Maya Patel: next steps: 1) payments-ops to hold off manual wire until Azure clears 2) payments-ops to open a ticket with Azure (we need the compliance review reason and expected clearance) 3) finance to notify partner with conservative ETA.
payments-ops: opening ticket TKT-5725 to Azure and linking RB-9723.
payments-ops: Ticket TKT-5725 created and assigned to payments-ops. Azure case ACZ-99812 referenced.
Oliver Park: if Azure finally declines the payout we may need to reverse ledger entries and issue credit or correction. check for related refunds or disputed orders in 72h window.
FinanceBot: Audit rule PM-44: if marketplace_status transitions from 'on_hold' -> 'skipped' then flag for manual review. RB-9723 flagged for this rule.
Dana Kim: partner asked if we can cover short-term liquidity if hold lasts past 5 business days. accounting, we have a partner reserve policy for holds >5 days?
Maya Patel: yes, policy allows advance manual wire up to 80% of expected payout from partner reserve, requires VP Finance signoff. we'll wait 48h for Azure response, then escalate.
payments-ops: Azure replied: compliance review reason - 'unusual pricing delta' detected, ETA 5-7 business days. they request supplemental pricing docs from vendor.
Dana Kim: passing to partner: please provide pricing change logs and invoice copies to Azure case ACZ-99812. cc: @Oliver Park.
Oliver Park: also we should patch payout connector: don't mark payment_status 'scheduled' until marketplace_status='released' AND bank_ref present. opened INFRA-3199 and linked RB-9723.
Maya Patel: INFRA-3199 created: "payout-connector: require bank_ref before marking 'scheduled'". add unit test for transition states.
Dana Kim: partner replied: they submitted docs to Azure and asked for weekly updates. they've requested we consider issuing interim payment.
Maya Patel: action: payments-ops to prepare manual wire option and estimate reserve drawdown. finance to route VP approval if Azure doesn't clear by 2026-04-20.
FinanceBot: RB-9723 updated: status='waiting_on_marketplace', action_items:["await_azure_response","prepare_manual_wire","monitor_case"]. reminder set 2026-04-20.
Oliver Park: noting for monthly close - mark these settlements as 'pending_marketplace_hold' to avoid premature recognition.
Dana Kim: thanks team. will update partner and close when Azure clears.
